enchantments.tooltip: Sacred +7: An item with this quality assists only wearers who have the ability to turn undead. Sacred items provide an +7 Enhancement bonus to your effective level for Turning Undead.
Hallowed: An item with this quality assists only wearers who have the ability to turn undead. Hallowed items provide an +7 Enhancement bonus to the maximum Hit Dice of undead turned.

Insightful Faith: An item with this quality assists only wearers who have the ability to turn undead. Insightful Faith items provide Insight Bonuses to the owner's effective level for the turning check by +2, their maximum Hit Dice turned by +2, and their total Hit Dice turned by +4.
Rough Hide +7: This item fuses with your body and toughens your skin, providing a +7 Primal bonus to your natural armor.
Lifesealed +22: You are immune to magical effects that cause instant death. In addition, you have a +22% enhancement bonus to Negative Energy Absorption.
Undying +85: Bound to service beyond death, you gain a +85 Enhancement bonus to your Incapacitation range.
